activity_statements.statement: issues private-label and co-branded credit cards for national and regional retailers, healthcare providers, and other merchant partners — leading provider of private-label credit cards in the US
operates CareCredit, a health and wellness credit card accepted at 270,000+ healthcare provider and retail locations including dental, veterinary, vision, pharmacy, and wellness sites
offers FDIC-insured savings products (high-yield savings accounts, CDs) through Synchrony Bank as an online bank
connects retail and healthcare partners to consumers through a digital financial ecosystem providing omnichannel financing and payment solutions
provides point-of-sale financing programs across retail, healthcare, home, auto, outdoor, pet, and telecommunications industries for merchant partners

name_reality_gap: The name 'Synchrony' is opaque and the index label 'Financial Services' gives no hint of the actual business. The firm is essentially a white-label credit card and financing infrastructure provider embedded inside retail and healthcare checkout flows — a B2B fintech as much as a consumer bank.
extraction_notes: Synchrony's main about page and Bank page were accessible; business-solutions and what-we-do pages timed out. Profile supplemented with CareCredit press releases that give clear evidence of partner-driven credit card business model.
